scope: Only the 2,016 direct remainder records; prior Sonnet labels were not reclassified.
method: Reviewed body profiles for every new record and explicitly authored all assignments.
Inspected full ambiguous records, including long descriptions in directories.
Screened all newly flagged text-table body cells for quantities, percentages and numerical measurements, then inspected candidates.
Distinguished dates, addresses, ordinal unit names and insignia descriptions from quantitative observations.
limitations: Profiles summarise long numeric series; not every numerical cell was individually reread. Semantic judgements remain open to user review.
